basic_profile.bio: Liam is a 31-year-old graphic designer living in Osaka, Japan. Originally from the UK, he moved to Japan three years ago to experience its vibrant culture and dig into the world of Pokémon. He spends his free time exploring new places, trying out vegan restaurants, and participating in local Pokémon Go events. He tends to be online during late evenings and weekends. Liam is in a long-distance relationship and often visits the UK. He is passionate about fashion, specifically Goth fashion, and enjoys incorporating it into his daily wardrobe.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Liam has a background in graphic design, which he studied at a university in the UK. He is self-taught in the nuances of Pokémon Go, having played since its release. His interest in veganism developed after moving to Japan, where he found a community of like-minded individuals.
